pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Small bug fix matching the PR words. It has one reasonable design, so no spec was needed.
No spec file in this change.
New tests cover %, _, mixed text and backslash. They would fail without the ESCAPE clause. Not run here because vitest is not installed; CI workflow exists.
README mentions only '?q= searches titles', which stays accurate.
The escape regex and ESCAPE '\\' are correct; the SQL string literal in JS yields ESCAPE '\'. The query is parameterized.
The query stays parameterized, and the escaping removes wildcard injection.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
Title and body match the diff. The '?q=%' claim and the test name are consistent with the diff.
